sourceTitle: Artists and Arabs; Or, Sketching in Sunshine
description: "Artists and Arabs; Or, Sketching in Sunshine" by Henry Blackburn is a travelogue written in the late 19th century. The text describes the experiences of an artist or a group of artists as they explore and sketch various landscapes, people, and cultures in North Africa, particularly Algeria.
